stories.title: OECD-Prognose: OECD hebt Konjunkturprognose für deutsche Wirtschaft leicht

en.title: OECD forecast: OECD slightly raises economic outlook for German economy
en.summary: The OECD has marginally improved its economic forecast for Germany compared to previous estimates, though this projection carries significant uncertainty.

stories.title: Konjunktur in Deutschland: OECD hebt Prognose deutlich auf plus 1,1 Prozent an

en.title: Economy in Germany: OECD significantly raises forecast to plus 1.1 percent
en.summary: Following major economic research institutes, the OECD has significantly raised its economic forecast for Germany to 1.1 percent growth, with economists also issuing warnings.

stories.title: Herbstgutachten: OECD hebt Wachstumsprognose für Deutschland deutlich an

en.title: Autumn assessment: OECD significantly raises growth forecast for Germany
en.summary: The OECD has substantially improved its assessment of Germany's economic situation compared to summer estimates. Chief economist Stefano Scarpetta views the fuel tax reduction critically and urges government reforms.

stories.title: Spritpreise nicht günstiger: ADAC fordert Abschaffung der Zwölf-Uhr-Regel an Tankstellen

en.title: Fuel prices not cheaper: ADAC calls for abolition of twelve o'clock rule at gas stations
en.summary: The ADAC concludes that the twelve o'clock rule at gas stations has failed to achieve lower fuel prices, noting fewer price changes but no actual cost reductions, while endorsing other measures.

stories.title: Womens Champions League: FC Bayern verspielt 2:0-Führung gegen Manchester City– Spielerinnen von Bengalo irritiert

en.title: Women's Champions League: FC Bayern squanders 2-0 lead against Manchester City – players irritated by flare
en.summary: FC Bayern suffered a setback in their Champions League season opener after blowing a 2-0 advantage against Manchester City. Bayern players criticized the referee after a smoke flare appeared on the pitch during an opposing goal.

stories.title: Mbappé schwärmt: „Klopp ist einer der besten Trainer der letzten 20 Jahre“

en.title: Mbappé praises: "Klopp is one of the best coaches of the last 20 years"
en.summary: Kylian Mbappé praised the newly appointed German national team coach Jürgen Klopp in an interview, revealing that Klopp once wanted to sign him for Liverpool. Mbappé cautioned against underestimating the German national team.

stories.title: Jürgen Klopp: Kylian Mbappé schwärmt vom neuen Bundestrainer vor dessen Debüt

en.title: Jürgen Klopp: Kylian Mbappé praises new German coach before his debut
en.summary: France's superstar Kylian Mbappé expressed admiration for newly appointed German national team coach Jürgen Klopp ahead of his first match on Thursday. Mbappé indicated he would have enjoyed playing under Klopp's management.

stories.title: ADAC fordert Abschaffung der 12-Uhr-Regel an Tankstellen

en.title: ADAC calls for abolition of 12 o'clock rule at petrol stations
en.summary: The ADAC automotive club is demanding the elimination of a rule limiting fuel price increases to noon only, arguing it has increased daily price volatility rather than reducing prices overall.

en.title: Oktoberfest: Waitresses revive festival visitors
en.summary: A 78-year-old man collapsed in a beer garden at Oktoberfest and was revived by waitstaff. A man was also arrested for upskirting in a festival tent.

stories.title: Auf Oktoberfest: Gelungene Wiederbelebung: Kellnerinnen retten Wiesnbesucher

en.title: At Oktoberfest: Successful resuscitation: waitresses save festival visitor
en.summary: Two waitresses at Oktoberfest noticed a man collapse and immediately provided assistance that saved the 78-year-old's life.

en.title: Oktoberfest: Chest compressions – waitresses save festival visitor
en.summary: Two waitresses at Oktoberfest witnessed a 78-year-old man collapse and performed lifesaving interventions that rescued him.

stories.title: FC Bayern vergibt Sieg gegen City

en.title: FC Bayern squanders victory against City
en.summary: FC Bayern drew 2:2 with Manchester City in their Champions League match, surrendering a comfortable lead. A flare played a decisive role in the first opposing goal.

stories.title: +++ Ukraine-Krieg +++: EU hebt Sanktionen gegen zwei russische Oligarchen auf – Baku lässt daraufhin zwei Franzosen frei

en.title: +++ Ukraine War +++: EU Lifts Sanctions Against Two Russian Oligarchs – Baku Then Releases Two French Citizens
en.summary: The EU lifted sanctions against two Russian oligarchs, after which Baku released two French citizens. Lavrov and Rubio met in New York, while the Kremlin sees no basis for peace talks.

stories.title: Monika Schnitzer: Die Koalition verteilt mit viel Empathie Beruhigungspillen

en.title: Monika Schnitzer: The Coalition Distributes Sedatives with Much Empathy
en.summary: The government uses measures like fuel discounts and energy aid to relieve citizens. A guest article criticizes that these only redistribute losses and turn every crisis into new demands on the state.

stories.title: Industrie: Der weltweit größte Autozulieferer Bosch wächst – allerdings nur noch durch Zukauf

en.title: Industry: World's Largest Auto Supplier Bosch Grows – But Only Through Acquisitions
en.summary: Bosch reported half-year results for the first time, with growth mainly driven by an acquisition in heating and climate systems. The automotive segment remains a concern for the company.

stories.title: Konjunktur: Umfragen deuten auf deutlich stärkeres Wachstum in Deutschland und Europa hin

en.title: Economic Growth: Surveys Point to Significantly Stronger Growth in Germany and Europe
en.summary: Purchasing manager indices for Germany and Europe significantly exceeded expectations. German industry is the main driver of economic growth in the region.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Dax notiert im Minus – Ölpreis sinkt weiter

en.title: Dax currently: Dax trading in negative – oil price continues to fall
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has reportedly resumed operations of its east-west pipeline to the Red Sea. Simultaneously, prospects for a diplomatic resolution in the Iran conflict may be increasing.
